hero.subheadline: A self service music machine for modern bars. Guests choose songs, pay directly on the machine. 25,000+ tracks. Zero hassle.

what.body1: SVANDA is a self-service karaoke box with a built-in jukebox. Guests walk up, browse thousands of songs on the touchscreen, pay at the card terminal, and grab the wireless mic. The box handles the queue, the lyrics display, and the payments on its own.
what.body2: Flip it between Karaoke mode for stage-style singalong with full lyrics on screen, and Jukebox mode for curated background music without a DJ. Run both at once, or switch depending on the night.

intro.tag: Self service karaoke & jukebox for bars
intro.descriptor1: SVANDA is a self service karaoke & jukebox machine built for bars, clubs, and events.
intro.descriptor2: Your guests walk up, browse thousands of songs, pay at the card terminal, grab the mic, and perform, all without a DJ or any staff involved. The machine handles the queue, the display, and the payments completely on its own, around the clock.
intro.bodyPara1: Karaoke with on-screen lyrics, plus a much larger jukebox library for background music. Czech, Slovak, English and more. Rock, pop, 80s, country, dance, wedding, metal.
intro.bodyPara2: Whatever your crowd is going to shout for, we probably have it. If something is missing, we add it in a few days.

statement.w6: ANY BAR.  ANY NIGHT.  ANY SONG.

catalogue.descriptor1: The biggest karaoke catalogue for self service venues.
catalogue.descriptor2: Czech, Slovak, international hits. Every genre, every decade.
catalogue.note: Payment via card terminal · 10 CZK per song

howItWorks.step2Detail: Pick any song from 18,000+. Pay at the card terminal.

offerings.venueSub: Permanent install. Bars, clubs, restaurants, bowling alleys, private clubs.
offerings.venueOption1Body: Install the box for free. Your guests pay 10 CZK per track at the card terminal. You host the machine, we handle the rest.
offerings.venueOption2Body: Rent the machine monthly and let guests sing for free. Good for member clubs, private spaces, or venues that want music included.
offerings.eventSub: One-off rentals for weddings, birthdays, corporate parties, festivals.
offerings.eventBody: We deliver, set up, and collect the machine. You choose whether guests pay per song or sing for free. Either way, SVANDA runs the music for the entire event. One-night minimum, multi-day packages available.

how.step1Body: Guests walk up to the touchscreen and search 5,000+ karaoke tracks or the full jukebox library.
how.step2Body: They tap their card at the terminal. 10 CZK per song. Skip this step if you are running the machine free.
how.step3Body: Grab the wireless microphone. Full lyrics scroll on the main screen so the whole room can join in.
how.step4Body: The box manages the playlist on its own. No one is running around asking who is next.

lemon.detail2: No staff. No downtime. Packed every weekend.
lemon.a1: We do. We deliver, install, connect the payment terminal and internet, and brief your staff. Usually 2 to 3 hours on site and you are live the same day.
lemon.a2: Yes. The song library streams from our servers and card payments need connectivity. Any decent venue Wi-Fi is enough.
lemon.q3: Can you add songs we are missing?
lemon.a3: Tell us what is missing and we will add it to the catalog, usually within a few days.
lemon.a4: We cover remote and on-site support. Most issues are resolved the same day.
lemon.q5: How much space does it take?
lemon.a5: About 1 m² of floor space and a power outlet. Screen, speakers, wireless mic, and card terminal are all built in.
lemon.q6: Is there a minimum rental for events?
lemon.a6: One night is the minimum. For weekends, festivals, or multi-day events we put together a package.
